observations: body: the page begins with the head of chapter 36 and has the head of chapter 37 at L28-L30; both heads are set in a larger type and centred. The line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the left margin, the locators «p. 112.» (L5) and «p. 113.» (L28, beside the head of chapter 37) in the right margin. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the heads: 5 stands in the space between the title of chapter 36 and its first line, beside no line; 35 beside the second line of the title of chapter 37.

body L29: «al-ǵawzahar» is italic, with the acute over the g. Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXI) say of this word in the title of chapter XXXVII that it is perhaps interpolated (with a reference to p. XLIII of the preface); it is kept as printed.
body L27: the letter of the reference (a) is bold italic; with chapter 36 the letters begin again at a.
body L7: a point stands before «elongationem»; it is not a sign.
notes_right L5: the Persian word گوزهر is printed with the stroke of the gāf ending in a blot.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
